messages.content:
Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

[{"id": "arka-v3-train-polish-0306", "row_sha256": "0de3f57fe7496cb5d25ef40f7431e52e6617ded12f4380a3de911dc4d8e0d340", "mode": "/polish", "language": "en", "context": {"profile": "Friendly and conversational."}, "identity": false, "mode_instructions": "Rewrite awkward phrasing into readable prose for the supplied profile, or plain prose when none is supplied. Preserve intent and certainty. Do not add a greeting, subject, signature, conclusion, or fact that the input did not supply.", "input": "the home energy monitor program for Cedar Lane residents starts April 8. from that week, staff will visit homes that signed up, and each visit takes around 30 minutes. they attach the monitor beside the electrical panel, where it measures the house's total electricity use. it doesn't show use by individual appliance. residents can see readings on a web dashboard, with views by hour and by day, and the dashboard refreshes every 15 minutes.

there is no charge for the monitor or installation. a home needs wi-fi for the dashboard. if the internet goes down, the monitor still collects readings, and they appear on the dashboard when the connection comes back. readings are kept for 12 months and can be viewed by the household and the Cedar Lane energy team. the team will use combined totals to plan energy workshops, not to rank individual homes.

residents who need to change their installation time can reply to the appointment email by April 3. the program is for monitoring electricity use; it does not control heating or other equipment.", "output": "The home energy monitor program for Cedar Lane residents starts April 8. Beginning that week, staff will visit homes that signed up. Each visit takes around 30 minutes. Staff will attach the monitor beside the electrical panel, where it measures the home's total electricity use. It does not show usage by individual appliance. Residents can view readings on a web dashboard by hour or by day. The dashboard refreshes every 15 minutes.

There is no charge for the monitor or installation. Homes need Wi-Fi to access the dashboard. If the internet goes down, the monitor will continue collecting readings, which will appear on the dashboard when the connection returns. Readings are kept for 12 months and can be viewed by the household and the Cedar Lane energy team. The team will use combined totals to plan energy workshops, not to rank individual homes.

Residents who need to change their installation time can reply to the appointment email by April 3. The program monitors electricity use; it does not control heating or other equipment."}]
